flags.why: The benefactor sense is the usual contemporary meaning and should precede the dated high-ranking-person sense.

The gentle meaning occurs in expressions such as dẽ tính and dẽ dàng, not as the standalone adverb illustrated by Mẹ dẽ bảo ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-d%E1%BA%BD)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 4; retain the gentle meaning under sense 3.

flags.why: Trái rạ is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/ra-ev88eYEo8XB0m.html)).
The entry omits the common meaning of shifting unwanted work or responsibility onto someone else ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91%C3%B9n)).
flags.fix: verb | to pass the buck; to shift unwanted work or responsibility onto someone else
